collection.title: Mercedes-Benz CLS Saloon 2015 to 2018 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Mercedes-Benz CLS Saloon 2015 to 2018 (218) model which requires a 24" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers. This model uses the Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
